positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "If we are serious about protecting women, then we will protect reproductive rights. In Congress, I will vote to codify Roe's protections into law. Let's put an end to this madness once and for all."

"In 2022, Carlos Gimenez celebrated the Dobbs decision. In 2023, Gimenez voted for the most anti-choice Speaker in American history. In 2024, Americans are going to hold Gimenez accountable. We will flip Florida's 28th blue."

"When Donald Trump ended Roe v. Wade, Carlos Giménez celebrated, putting his own political career ahead of women in Florida and across our country. Well, guess what, we are going to remove Giménez this year and codify Roe."

"In 2022, Carlos Gimenez celebrated the Dobbs decision. In 2023, Gimenez Voted in favor of the most anti-choice Speaker in American history. In 2024, Americans are going to hold Gimenez accountable. We will flip Florida's 28th blue."
"Restore women’s reproductive rights by eliminating government overreach"

evidence.text: "Paid family leave should be the standard in our nation. New parents need to be able to care for their newborns during the first few delicate weeks of their life. I fully support the FMLA and will continue to fight for it."

positions.question: Do you support the US providing increased offensive military aid to Ukraine?

evidence.text: "Gimenez is actively supporting abandoning Ukraine and our allies when they need us most. It's shameful."
